Name: Bath & Body Works Inc.
Description: Bath & Body Works Inc. (BBWI) is a leading specialty retailer distinguished by its extensive range of premium personal care and home fragrance products. With a strong omnichannel strategy that seamlessly merges its expansive retail footprint with a vibrant e-commerce platform, the company prioritizes customer accessibility and engagement. As a subsidiary of L Brands, Inc., BBWI benefits from operational synergies while fostering innovation in product offerings to align with evolving consumer preferences. The company is dedicated to sustainability and community stewardship, positioning itself for long-term growth and competitive resilience in the dynamic beauty and personal care market.
